outcome: Declaring a custom-element prop whose name already exists on the element warns in development instead of silently shadowing it

acceptance_criteria.text: Declaring a prop whose name collides with a property the element already has produces a development warning naming the prop.

expected_verification.assertion: defining a custom element with a prop named after an existing element property warns, and the message names the prop

acceptance_criteria.text: A prop name that does not collide produces no warning, so the check does not fire on ordinary declarations.

expected_verification.assertion: defining a custom element with an ordinary prop name produces no warning
